items.detail: Docs: 'Pointer to the aquifer initialization file'. uses(aqudb%aqu_ini) -> only aqu_read_init_cs.f90:82/99 'if (aqu_init_dat_c_cs(isp_ini)%name == aqudb(iaq)%aqu_ini)'; aqu_init_dat_c_cs is read from initial.aqu_cs (file_io initial.aqu_cs -> aqu_read_init_cs.f90:63). initial.aqu itself (aqu_init_dat_c) is never read (uses=none). The pointer resolves into initial.aqu_cs, not initial.aqu; it only drives pesticide/pathogen constituent initialisation.

ptln_eff = bmp_pn. Docs unit 'percent' (range 0.0-100.0), but the code applies the value as a fraction: smp_bmpfixed.f90:56 '(1. - hru(j)%lumv%bmp_pn)'. An entry of 20 (percent) gives a factor of (1 - 20) = -19. Example file uses 0.2.

ptlp_eff = bmp_pp. Docs unit 'percent' (range 0.0-100.0), but the code applies the value as a fraction: smp_bmpfixed.f90:49-51 '(1. - hru(j)%lumv%bmp_pp)'. An entry of 20 (percent) gives a factor of (1 - 20) = -19. Example file uses 0.2.

sed_eff = bmp_sed. Docs unit 'percent' (range 0.0-100.0), but the code applies the value as a fraction: smp_bmpfixed.f90:46 'sedyld(j) = sedyld(j) * (1. - hru(j)%lumv%bmp_sed)'. An entry of 20 (percent) gives a factor of (1 - 20) = -19. Example file uses 0.2.

soln_eff = bmp_sn. Docs unit 'percent' (range 0.0-100.0), but the code applies the value as a fraction: smp_bmpfixed.f90:58-59 '(1. - hru(j)%lumv%bmp_sn)'. An entry of 20 (percent) gives a factor of (1 - 20) = -19. Example file uses 0.2.

solp_eff = bmp_sp. Docs unit 'percent' (range 0.0-100.0), but the code applies the value as a fraction: smp_bmpfixed.f90:53 '(1. - hru(j)%lumv%bmp_sp)'. An entry of 20 (percent) gives a factor of (1 - 20) = -19. Example file uses 0.2.

If conds > 0, conds further lines are read per parameter: either 'range var val1 val2' or a calibration_conditions record 'var alt targ targc' (cal_parmchg_read.f90:93-101; calibration_data_module.f90:14-19). No docs table.
After obj_tot the code reads obj_tot integers (elem_cnt) on the same line: cal_parmchg_read.f90:75-77 '(elem_cnt(isp), isp = 1, nspu)'. No docs row.

Docs 'obj_tot: Total number of objects'. Code reads it into num_tot = 'total number of integers read in' (calibration_data_module.f90:34) and then reads that many integers as an object list in which a negative number marks a range end, e.g. '1 -5 18' gives num_tot=3, num_elem=6 (define_unit_elements, cal_parmchg_read.f90:149-153); 0 means all objects of the parameter's type (cal_parmchg_read.f90:106-147). So it is the count of listed integers, not of objects.
Docs 'gwflow: Flood routing'. Code gwflow is the gwflow module switch: '0 = gwflow module not active; 1 = gwflow module active' (basin_module.f90:70); used e.g. basin_read_objs.f90:46.

Code reads a 26th value idc_till (integer, default 3) as part of bsn_cc: 'tillage method to use if cswat = 2' (1 dssat, 2 epic, 3 Kemanian, 4 dndc) basin_module.f90:71-74; used in cbn_zhang2.f90:359. Example file header also has idc_till.
Docs 'cha_q': unit %, range 0.0-100.0. Code uses a fraction: smp_filter.f90:90 'drain_vfs2 = ((1. - hru(j)%lumv%vfsch) * hru(j)%lumv%vfscon)* hru(j)%area_ha'.

Docs 'aqu_sp_yld': 'Specific yield of the shallow aquifer', unit mm (a specific yield is dimensionless). uses(hlt_db%sy) -> only cal_parm_select.f90:1019 and output calsoft_control.f90:82. Never used in the HRU-lte water balance.

Docs 'End of growing season for non-tropical/start of monsoon initialization period for tropical'. Code igrow2 'end of growing season for non-tropical (pl_end_sum) end of monsoon initialization period for tropical' (hru_lte_module.f90:39). Docs say 'start' for the tropical case (copy of the grow_start row).

Docs 'bed_load: Percent of sediment entering the channel that is bed material'. Code column is bankfull_flo 'bank full flow rate' (sd_channel_module.f90:36), a multiplier on the bankfull flow rate (sd_channel_sediment3.f90:112 'bf_flow = sd_ch(ich)%bankfull_flo * ch_rcurv(ich)%elev(2)%flo_rate'); and the input is overwritten with 1.5 each call (sd_channel_sediment3.f90:78). No bed-load fraction is read. The replacing column bankfull_flo is reset to 1.5 every channel step (sd_channel_sediment3.f90:78), so its input has no effect either.

Docs 'eq_slp: Equilibrium channel slope' (m/m). Code column is vcr_coef 'critical velocity coefficient' (sd_channel_module.f90:30), used as a multiplier: sd_channel_sediment3.f90:177 'vel_cr = sd_ch(ich)%vcr_coef * vel_cr'. Editor still labels it eq_slp.

Docs 'erod_fact: Channel erodibility factor'. Code column is bank_exp 'bank erosion exponent' (sd_channel_module.f90:27); its only process use is commented out (sd_channel_sediment3.f90:195 '!ebank_m = 0.00024 * (vel_rch / vel_cr) ** sd_ch(ich)%bank_exp'), so the value has no effect in 62.0.1.

Code reads 'order' (integer, stream order) as the 2nd value (sd_channel_module.f90:20); used e.g. sd_hydsed_init.f90:75, sd_channel_sediment3.f90:65, conditions.f90:726. Example header and Editor have 'order'. Every later docs row is therefore one position early.

Docs unit 'm' for 'Channel side slope'. Code chss is a dimensionless ratio (units none): ch_rthr.f90:160 'topw = ... + 2. * rcurv%dep * sd_ch(jrch)%chss', sd_hydsed_init.f90:154 'p = b + 2. * Sqrt(dep ** 2 * (1. + 1. / (sd_ch(i)%chss ** 2)))'.

Docs: 'Sediment concentration in lateral and groundwater flow' (mg/L). Code applies it to lateral plus TILE flow: swr_latsed.f90:38 'sedyld(j) = sedyld(j) + hru(j)%hyd%lat_sed * hru(j)%area_ha * (latq(j) + qtile) / 100000.' -- not groundwater. The /100000 factor confirms mg/L (code declaration comment 'g/L' is stale).

Docs 'shp_co1': 'Shape coefficient 1 for reservoirs'. Code: res_initial.f90:57-58 '!! use br1 as lag - then compute actual br1 (no option to input actual br1)'; 'res_ob(ires)%lag_up = res_hyd(ires)%br1'; used res_control.f90:142 'alpha_up = Exp(-res_ob(jres)%lag_up)' to smooth outflow. The surface-area shape coefficients are computed from psa/pvol/esa/evol (res_initial.f90:62-80). (uses found via component query 'br1'; source read to confirm.)
Docs 'shp_co2': 'Shape coefficient 2 for reservoirs'. Code: 'res_ob(ires)%lag_down = res_hyd(ires)%br2' (res_initial.f90:59); res_control.f90:143 'alpha_down = Exp(-res_ob(jres)%lag_down)'.

Docs list irr_amt 4th; code reads amt_mm 'irrigation application amount' [mm] 2nd (mgt_operations_module.f90:7, read as the derived type at mgt_read_irrops.f90:48). Example header 'amt_mm eff_frac sumq_frac ...' follows the code.
Docs list irr_eff 2nd; code reads eff 'irrigation in-field efficiency' 3rd (mgt_operations_module.f90:8). A file written in docs order puts the efficiency (0-1) into amt_mm.
Docs list surq_rto 3rd; code reads surq 'surface runoff ratio' 4th (mgt_operations_module.f90:9).

Code reads area_ha 'area of landscape cataloging unit - hectares' (calibration_data_module.f90:195) between name and the element count (lsu_read_elements.f90:65,70). Example file header has 'area'. A file written per the docs would have elem_tot read as area and the first element number read as the element count.
Docs put elem_tot 3rd; code reads it 4th (after area_ha). Meaning OK: number of entries in the element list.

Docs put elements 4th; code reads the element list from the 5th column on (elem_cnt(1..nspu)); negative numbers denote ranges (same convention as calibration.cal). Also a label typo: the Editor/example files call it `elem_cnt`.

dtbl_lum_read.f90:72-75: when var == "prob_unif" the line is re-read as 'dtbl_lum(i)%cond(ic)%var, dtbl_lum(i)%frac_app' (fraction of time the application occurs; uses conditions.f90:493 'if (ran_num < d_tbl%frac_app)'). This alternate condition-line layout is not documented.

Docs unit 'm/day or m/hr'. Input is always per day: ch_read_nut.f90:111 'ch_nut(ich)%rs1 = ch_nut(ich)%rs1 / real(time%step)' converts to per time step; a per-hour input would be divided again.
Docs 'mg O2/m2*day or mg O2/m2*hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:119.
Docs 'mg P/m2*day or mg P/m2*hr'; input per day, divided by time%step at ch_read_nut.f90:112.

Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:120 '/ real(time%step)'.
Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:121.
Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:122.
Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:114.
Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:123.
Docs '1/day or 1/hr'; input per day, ch_read_nut.f90:115.

Docs 'chla_co: Chlorophyll-a production coefficient'. Code column is nsolr 'loss rate for souble n - no3, nh3, no2' (reservoir_data_module.f90:117), used in res_nutrient.f90:64 'nitrosolk = (conc_soln - conc_nmin) * Theta(nsolr, ...)'. Example header still says chla_co.

mid_n_stl = nsetlr1. Code treats it as a dimensionless rate coefficient on the concentration excess, not a settling velocity: res_nutrient.f90:57 'nitrok = (conc_n - wbody_prm%nut%conc_nmin) * Theta(nsetlr, ...)', capped at 1 (comment at :55 'Ikenberry wetland eqs modified - not function of area'). Code comment gives unit 'frac' (reservoir_data_module.f90:113). Docs unit m/day is the SWAT2012 meaning.

mid_p_stl = psetlr1 (same treatment for P, res_nutrient.f90:60). Code treats it as a dimensionless rate coefficient on the concentration excess, not a settling velocity: res_nutrient.f90:57 'nitrok = (conc_n - wbody_prm%nut%conc_nmin) * Theta(nsetlr, ...)', capped at 1 (comment at :55 'Ikenberry wetland eqs modified - not function of area'). Code comment gives unit 'frac' (reservoir_data_module.f90:115). Docs unit m/day is the SWAT2012 meaning.

n_stl = nsetlr2. Code treats it as a dimensionless rate coefficient on the concentration excess, not a settling velocity: res_nutrient.f90:57 'nitrok = (conc_n - wbody_prm%nut%conc_nmin) * Theta(nsetlr, ...)', capped at 1 (comment at :55 'Ikenberry wetland eqs modified - not function of area'). Code comment gives unit 'frac' (reservoir_data_module.f90:114). Docs unit m/day is the SWAT2012 meaning.

p_stl = psetlr2. Code treats it as a dimensionless rate coefficient on the concentration excess, not a settling velocity: res_nutrient.f90:57 'nitrok = (conc_n - wbody_prm%nut%conc_nmin) * Theta(nsetlr, ...)', capped at 1 (comment at :55 'Ikenberry wetland eqs modified - not function of area'). Code comment gives unit 'frac' (reservoir_data_module.f90:116). Docs unit m/day is the SWAT2012 meaning.

Docs 'secchi_co: Water clarity coefficient'. Code column is psolr 'loss rate for soluble p' (reservoir_data_module.f90:118), used in res_nutrient.f90:67 'phossolk = (conc_solp - conc_pmin) * Theta(psolr, ...)'. Example header still says secchi_co.

Docs 'Peak rate adjustment factor for sediment routing in the subbasin (tributary channels)' (SWAT2012 ADJ_PKR meaning). In 62.0.1 adj_pkr's only process use is scaling the weather-generator half-hour rainfall fraction: cli_initwgn.f90:294 'wgn_pms(iwgn)%amp_r(mon) = bsn_prm%adj_pkr * (1. - Exp(...))'.

Docs unit ppm but default 1.57 and range 1-5 are not ppm-scale. Code: basin_prm_default.f90:51 'if (bsn_prm%co2 < 100.) bsn_prm%co2 = 400.' and pl_biomass_gro.f90:43 'if (bsn_prm%co2 > 350.)'; a documented value 1-5 is silently replaced by 400 ppm.
Docs unit '10m^3/M' is truncated; code units for pperco are 10 m^3/Mg (nut_solp.f90:69 '.1 * hru(j)%nut%pperco * soil(j)%phys(ly)%bd'). Description otherwise matches.

Docs 'Peak rate adjustment factor for sediment routing in the main channel'. Code prf is 'peak rate factor for peak rate equation' (basin_module.f90:84) used in the HRU NRCS peak-runoff equation: ero_pkq.f90:52 'qp_cfs = bsn_prm%prf / 6578.6 * hru(j)%area_ha * qday / tconc(j)'. Not channel sediment routing.
Then one benthic concentration per pesticide: pest_water_ini%benthic (constituent_mass_module.f90:334).

Docs 'hmet' (pointer to hmet_hru.ini) is soil_plant.ini's hmetc column; not read from pest_water.ini. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'hmet' (pointer to hmet_hru.ini) belongs to soil_plant.ini; not read from pest_water.ini.]

Docs 'name: Name of initial soil plant' describes the name column of soil_plant.ini (soil_plant_init.f90:47-48; hru_module.f90:128-136). pest_water.ini's first value is a pesticide water-initialisation record name (pest_cha_res_read.f90:62), referenced from initial.cha/initial.res pest pointers. [Run 2: MEANING-CHANGED – Docs: 'Name of initial soil plant'. Code reads the name of a pesticide water-initialisation record (pest_init_name, matched from initial.cha/initial.res/initial]

Docs 'nut' (pointer to nutrients.sol) is soil_plant.ini's nutc column; not read from pest_water.ini. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'nut' (pointer to nutrients.sol) belongs to soil_plant.ini; not read from pest_water.ini.]

Docs 'path' (pointer to path_hru.ini) is soil_plant.ini's pathc column; not read from pest_water.ini. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'path' (pointer to path_hru.ini) belongs to soil_plant.ini; not read from pest_water.ini.]

Docs 'pest' (pointer to pest_hru.ini) is soil_plant.ini's pestc column; not read from pest_water.ini. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'pest' (pointer to pest_hru.ini) belongs to soil_plant.ini; not read from pest_water.ini.]

Docs 'salt' (pointer to salt_hru.ini) is soil_plant.ini's saltc column; not read from pest_water.ini. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'salt' (pointer to salt_hru.ini) belongs to soil_plant.ini; not read from pest_water.ini.]

Docs 'sw_frac: Fraction of soil water' is soil_plant.ini's sw_frac column (soil_plant_init.f90:47; hru_module.f90:130); pest_water.ini has no such value. [Run 2: EXTRA – Docs 'sw_frac' (fraction of soil water) is a soil_plant.ini column; pest_water.ini reader (pest_cha_res_read.f90:62-64) reads no such value.]
Value line starts with a label token read into titldum and discarded (pest_cha_res_read.f90:64).
Then one water concentration per pesticide in the simulation (cs_db%num_pests): pest_water_ini%water (constituent_mass_module.f90:333).

Docs 'aq_reac: Aquatic pesticide reaction coefficient' [1/day]. Code column is aq_hlife 'aquatic half-life' [days] (pesticide_data_module.f90:12), used as a half-life: ch_rtpest.f90:124 'decay_temp_adjust(pestdb(jpst)%aq_hlife, temp_wat)'. Example header 'aq_hlife'. A rate entered per the docs is read as a half-life (inverse quantity).
Same column (ben_act_dep 'depth of active benthic layer'), but docs unit 'm/day' is wrong; code unit is 'm' (pesticide_data_module.f90:17).

Docs 'ben_reac: Reaction coefficient in the benthic sediment' [1/day]. Code column is ben_hlife 'half-life of pest in benthic sediment' [days] (pesticide_data_module.f90:19), used as a half-life: ch_rtpest.f90:219 'decay_temp_adjust(pestdb(jpst)%ben_hlife, temp_wat)'.
Code reads descrip (character(32), pesticide description) as the last value (pesticide_data_module.f90:23).
Code reads harvest_sink '1=plant is 100% sink; 0=accumulates in pl_in, returned to soil on harvest/kill' (pesticide_data_module.f90:21); used mgt_harvbiomass.f90:82, mgt_harvtuber.f90:88.
Code reads pl_uptake 'fraction taken up by plant' (pesticide_data_module.f90:20); used pest_pl_up.f90:54.
Code reads resistance_n 'resistance blending: 0=actual st conc; 1=field-capacity conc' (pesticide_data_module.f90:22); used pest_pl_up.f90:72.
Read by 62.0.1 (input_file_module.f90:145-146; water_allocation_read.f90) in place of water_allocation.wro, which nothing reads any more; the docs have no page.

Docs 'yrs_init: Age of plant at start of simulation' [years]. Code fr_yrmat is a fraction of years-to-maturity: plant_init.f90:311 'curyr_mat = int (pcomdb(icom)%pl(ipl)%fr_yrmat * float(pldb(idp)%mat_yrs))' and plant_init.f90:293-294 uses it directly as maturity fraction for canopy height. Entering an age (e.g. 10 years) is read as 10x maturity.

Docs 'bm_tree_acc: Fraction of biomass accumulated each year'. Code column is laixco_tree 'coefficient to estimate max lai during tree growth' (plant_data_module.f90:81), used as an exponent multiplier on years-to-maturity: pl_leaf_gro.f90:114 'lai_exp = rto * pldb(idp)%laixco_tree'.

If codes.bsn nam1 ('event') /= 0 the reader also takes pl_class (character) after the record: plant_parm_read.f90:57 'read (104,*,iostat=eof) pldb(ic), pl_class(ic)'. Conditional column; not documented.
3rd res_part_fracs value lig_frac, used as below-ground lignin fraction when carbon=2 (plant_parm_read.f90:62).

Code reads 3 more reals as nested res_part_fracs (plant_data_module.f90:9-17, 104); with codes.bsn carbon=2 they set lignin/structural fractions: plant_parm_read.f90:61-63 'cswat_1_part_fracs(ic)%lig_frac_blg = pldb(ic)%res_part_fracs%lig_frac'. Value 1 is meta_frac ('reads plants.plt avg_lig_frac').
2nd res_part_fracs value str_frac, used as above-ground lignin fraction when carbon=2 (plant_parm_read.f90:63).
Read by 62.0.1 (input_file_module.f90:145-146; water_allocation_read.f90) in place of water_allocation.wro, which nothing reads any more; the docs have no page.
If aa_int_cnt > 0 the same line carries that many years: basin_print_codes_read.f90:36 'read (107,*,iostat=eof) pco%aa_numint, (pco%aa_yrs(ii), ii = 1, pco%aa_numint)'. No docs row.

Docs 'dbout: Code for printing output in DB format'. Code reads use_obj_labels here (basin_print_codes_read.f90:44), 'code to read in the print.prt print objects respecting the label' (basin_module.f90:171): 'n' reads the object lines in fixed order (:57-175), anything else reads them by name (:177-767). No database output switch is read. Example header (Editor v2.2.0) still says 'dbout'.

items.detail: Docs place 'salt_name' at value 15; code reads salt as value 7 (recalldb_read.f90:49-52) because no unit/tstep values are read. Docs row has no description or type either.

Same column (nsed, equilibrium/normal sediment concentration) but docs unit 'kg/L' is wrong: no conversion is applied after the read (res_read_sed.f90:55) and res_sediment.f90:36-38 compares it directly with sed_ppm, so the input is mg/L (ppm). Code comment 'read in as mg/L and convert to kg/L' (reservoir_data_module.f90:100) is stale. Docs default 1.0 and range 1-5000 fit mg/L.
When codes.bsn nam1 ('event') /= 0 the reader takes an 8th value csc (constituent pointer): soil_plant_init.f90:50-52; used hru_read.f90:123.

Docs put 'hmet' 6th (before salt). Code reads saltc 6th and hmetc 7th: soil_plant_init.f90:48 '... sol_plt_ini(ii)%pathc, sol_plt_ini(ii)%saltc, sol_plt_ini(ii)%hmetc'. Docs also call hmet 'Currently not used' although hru_read.f90:109 resolves it against hmet_hru.ini. The example header (Editor v2.2.0) has the same hmet-before-salt order, so its 'hmet' value is read as the salt pointer. [Run 2: WRONG-COLUMN – Docs row 6 is 'hmet' ('Currently not used'), but the 6th column the code reads is saltc (soil_plant_init.f90:47 order ... pathc, saltc, hmetc); uses -> hru_read]

Docs put 'salt' 7th (last). Code reads saltc 6th (soil_plant_init.f90:48); a value in the docs' 7th column is read as hmetc. [Run 2: WRONG-COLUMN – Docs row 7 is 'salt' (pointer to salt init), but the 7th column the code reads is hmetc, which is used (hru_read.f90:109 matches hmet_soil_ini names) -- not 'cu]

Same column (dist 'distance between two drain tubes or tiles'), but docs unit 'm' (default 5.0, range 5-100) is wrong: the code comment gives mm (hru_module.f90:91) and swr_drains.f90:136-141 divides ad = soil zmx - drain depth (both mm) by dist and adds it to radius-based terms in mm, so dist must be in mm (SWAT2012 SDRAIN is also mm). A value of 30 entered as metres is read as 30 mm. (Raised after ANT gemma26 flagged the unit; audit first left it unsettled.) Copied unconverted (structure_set_parms: hru(j)%sdr = sdr(istr)) into swr_drains.f90:138 'ad / dist' with ad in mm, so the input is mm.
Docs list 'pet' last (10th). Code reads petgage 8th, before atmodep (climate_module.f90:123-124; read cli_staread.f90:68). Field-map: petgage -> Editor 'pet'.
Docs unit 'mm' for 'Skew coefficient for daily precipitation'. Code pcpskw units none; used as dimensionless skew: cli_initwgn.f90:271 'r6 = wgn(iwgn)%pcpskw(mon) / 6.'.

items.page: *.con (hru, hru-lte, rout_unit, aquifer, channel, reservoir, recall, exco, delratio, outlet, chandeg, gwflow)
items.detail: Docs 'rule: Currently not used'. Code ruleset 'points to the name of the dtbl in flo_con.dtl for out flow control' (hydrograph_module.f90:348) and is used: dtbl_flocon_read.f90:79-81 matches ob(iob)%ruleset against flow-control decision tables (called main.f90.in:91). Docs type 'integer' is also wrong: ruleset is character(16).

Docs: 'Organic carbon in aquifer' (percent) as an active input. uses(aqu_dat%cbn) -> only copy aqu_initial.f90:176 'aqu_d(iaq)%cbn = aqu_dat(iaq)%cbn' and calibration cal_parm_select.f90:951; uses(aqu_d%cbn) -> reads=none. Value never reaches a calculation or condition.
Docs: 'Average flow distance to stream or object' (m). uses(aqu_dat%flo_dist) -> only cal_parm_select.f90:955 (calibration chg_par); uses(aqudb%flo_dist) none. Never used by aquifer routing.

Docs type 'integer'; code timestep is character(len=2) (climate_module.f90:210) compared with 'aa'/'mo'/'yr' (cli_read_atmodep.f90:44 'if (atmodep_cont%timestep == "yr")'). The docs' own option page timestep.md lists mo/yr/aa, so only the Type cell is wrong.

bact_eff = bmp_bac is copied to the HRU (structure_set_parms.f90:108) but never applied (smp_bmpfixed.f90 has no bacteria reduction; grep %bmp_bac: copy only). Docs also give 'percent' where the sibling values are fractions.

Same column (inject_dep 'injection depth' mm, mgt_operations_module.f90:103) but no code reads it - grep finds only the declaration - so the value has no effect, while the docs present it as active (no 'not used' note, unlike its neighbours).

Docs 'event: Currently not used'. Code nam1 is commented 'not used' (basin_module.f90:24) but it switches input layouts: plant_parm_read.f90:54-58 reads an extra pl_class column from plants.plt when nam1 /= 0, and soil_plant_init.f90:46-52 reads an extra csc column from soil_plant.ini when nam1 /= 0.

Docs 'sed_det: Currently not used'. Code sed_det selects the peak runoff rate method: ero_pkq.f90:43 'if (bsn_cc%sed_det == 1)' half-hour rainfall intensity method, else NRCS dimensionless hydrograph with PRF (basin_module.f90:30-32).
Docs: 'Channel nutrient soft calibration'. uses(cal_codes%chnut) -> only calsoft_read_codes.f90:39 (sets generic cal_soft flag).

Docs: 'Land phase nutrient soft calibration'. uses(cal_codes%nut) -> only calsoft_read_codes.f90:39-42, where any 'y' just sets cal_soft = 'y'. No nutrient soft-calibration routine reads it; setting it alone runs no nutrient calibration.
Docs: 'Reservoir soft calibration'. uses(cal_codes%res) -> only calsoft_read_codes.f90:39 (sets generic cal_soft flag); no reservoir soft-calibration code reads it.

Docs 'flag_fs: Currently not used'. Code vfsi 'on/off flag for vegetative filter strip' (mgt_operations_module.f90:32) is copied to the HRU (structure_set_parms.f90:47) and gates the filter-strip routine: hru_control.f90:612 'if (hru(j)%lumv%vfsi > 0.) then call smp_filter'. With flag 0 (as in the refdata example) the filter strip does nothing.
Docs 'aqu_dp_flo': 'Initial deep aquifer flow'. uses(hlt_db%gwdeep) -> only cal_parm_select.f90:1040 and output.
Docs 'aqu_init': 'Initial shallow aquifer storage'. uses(hlt_db%gw) -> only cal_parm_select.f90:1034 and output.
Docs 'aqu_sh_flo': 'Initial shallow aquifer flow'. uses(hlt_db%gwflow) -> only cal_parm_select.f90:1037 and output.
Docs 'trop_flag': 'Tropical flag' (default non_trop). uses(hlt_db%tropical) -> only output calsoft_control.f90:82.

Same column (d50 'channel median sediment size', sd_channel_module.f90:31), but the input has no effect: sd_channel_sediment3.f90:80 sets 'sd_ch(ich)%d50 = 1.0' every call before its use at :252,:255. Reset to 1.0 every channel step (sd_channel_sediment3.f90:80) before use.

Same column (frac 'fraction of hru that drains into impoundment', reservoir_data_module.f90:93), but no code reads wet_hyd()%frac or wet_hyddb()%frac (grep: declaration and read only), so the value has no effect while the docs present it as active.

uses(aqu_init_dat_c) -> reads=none; writers none. aquifer.aqu 'init' is compared with initial.aqu_cs names instead (aqu_read_init_cs.f90:82). Confirmed by source read: aqu_read_init.f90:53 is the only reference.

Docs 'Pointer to the organic and mineral initialization file'. initial.aqu values are read into aqu_init_dat_c (aqu_read_init.f90:53) but aqu_init_dat_c is never referenced again in 62.0.1 (grep: only aqu_read_init.f90:44,53). Pesticide/pathogen/salt pointers for aquifers are taken from initial.aqu_cs (aqu_read_init_cs.f90:38-63, type aquifer_init_data_char_cs). The org_min pointer has no effect (aqu_read_init.f90:63-68 loop body is commented out).

Docs 'Pointer to the pesticide initialization file'. initial.aqu values are read into aqu_init_dat_c (aqu_read_init.f90:53) but aqu_init_dat_c is never referenced again in 62.0.1 (grep: only aqu_read_init.f90:44,53). Pesticide/pathogen/salt pointers for aquifers are taken from initial.aqu_cs (aqu_read_init_cs.f90:38-63, type aquifer_init_data_char_cs).

Docs 'Pointer to the salt initialization file'. initial.aqu values are read into aqu_init_dat_c (aqu_read_init.f90:53) but aqu_init_dat_c is never referenced again in 62.0.1 (grep: only aqu_read_init.f90:44,53). Pesticide/pathogen/salt pointers for aquifers are taken from initial.aqu_cs (aqu_read_init_cs.f90:38-63, type aquifer_init_data_char_cs). Salt pointer is read from initial.aqu_cs (aqu_read_init_cs.f90:115).

Docs 'Pointer to the salt initialization file'. initial.cha's salt is read (ch_read_init.f90:49) but never used: the salt lookup uses ch_init_cs(isp_ini)%salt from initial.cha_cs (sd_channel_read.f90:260; ch_read_init_cs.f90:48).
Docs 'path: Currently not used'. Code resolves it against pathogen water-initialisation records: res_read.f90:102 'if (res_init_dat_c(isp_ini)%path == path_init_name(ics))' and wet_initial.f90:68.

Docs 'Pointer to the salt initialization file'. initial.res salt is read but never referenced (res_read.f90:109 has only the comment '!! initial salts'); reservoir salt initialisation comes from reservoir.res_cs (res_read_salt_cs.f90:27-43).
Docs 'irr_dep': 'Depth of application for subsurface irrigation' (mm). uses(irrop_db%dep_mm) -> reads=none. Also a label typo: the Editor/example files call it `dep_sub`.
Docs 'irr_po4': 'Concentration of phosphate in irrigation water'. uses(irrop_db%po4) -> reads=none. Also a label typo: the Editor/example files call it `po4_ppm`.

Docs 'irr_salt': 'Concentration of total salt in irrigation water'. uses(irrop_db%salt) -> only copy mgt_sched.f90:533 'irrig(j)%salt = irrop_db(mgt%op1)%salt'; uses(irrig%salt) -> reads=none. Also a label typo: the Editor/example files call it `salt_ppm`.

Docs 'hu_sch: Currently not used' (and page prose says heat-unit scheduling must be done with a decision table). Code reads husc (read_mgtops.f90:30) and uses it to schedule operations by heat units: mgt_operatn.f90:71 'do while (mgt%husc > 0. .and. aphu > mgt%husc)' (mgt_operatn called from hru_control.f90:308).
Docs 'bact_die' (coliform die-off). uses(ch_nut%rk5) -> only ch_read_nut.f90:102 (default 2.0). Never used.
Docs 'ben_cst'. uses(ch_nut%rs7) -> only ch_read_nut.f90:98 (default) and cal_parm_select.f90:589.
Docs 'cst_decay'. uses(ch_nut%rk6) -> only ch_read_nut.f90:103 (default) and cal_parm_select.f90:613.
Docs 'cst_stl' (arbitrary constituent settling). uses(ch_nut%rs6) -> only ch_read_nut.f90:97 (zero->2.5 default) and cal_parm_select.f90:585. Never used in water-quality routing.
Docs 'plt_n': 'Channel organic N concentration' (ppm). uses(ch_nut%onco) -> reads=none.
Docs 'plt_p': 'Channel organic P concentration' (ppm). uses(ch_nut%opco) -> reads=none. Also a label typo: the Editor/example files call it `ptl_p`.

Docs 'integer'; code lao is 'real' (channel_data_module.f90:132). Harmless for reading (an integer literal reads into a real) but the declared type differs. [Run 2: MEANING-CHANGED – Docs 'q2e_lt': 'Qual2E light averaging option' (integer). uses(ch_nut%lao) -> only ch_read_nut.f90:62 'if (ch_nut(ich)%lao <= 0) ch_nut(ich)%lao = 2'; never rea]
Docs 'can': 'Currently not used'. uses(sp_ob%canal) -> hyd_connect.f90:105 'if (sp_ob%canal > 0) then'.
Docs 'cha': 'Currently not used'. uses(sp_ob%chan) -> allocate, loop bounds (basin_channel_output.f90:15 'do ich = 1, sp_ob%chan'), conditions (7).
Docs 'pmp': 'Currently not used'. uses(sp_ob%pump) -> hyd_connect.f90:109 'if (sp_ob%pump > 0) then'.
Docs: 'Maximum overland flow Manning's n value'. uses(overland_n%ovn_max) -> reads=none.
Docs: 'Minimum overland flow Manning's n value'. uses(overland_n%ovn_min) -> reads=none.

Docs type 'real'; code day_lag_mx is 'integer' (basin_module.f90:132), read list-directed, so a real-formatted value (e.g. '2.0') fails the read. 'Currently not used' is true in effect: basin_prm_default.f90:60 overwrites it with 2. [Run 2: MEANING-CHANGED – Docs 'day_lag_max': 'Currently not used', type real. Code: integer day_lag_mx ('max days to lag hydrographs for hru, ru and channels'); uses -> allocate, loop b]

Docs say 'Currently not used' but the code uses it: the column is temp_decay 'pesticide temperature decay factor' (basin_module.f90:86), used as a switch in aqu_1d_control.f90:317 and ch_rtpest.f90:123,218 'if (bsn_prm%temp_decay == 1)'. Docs label exp_sed belongs to a SWAT2012 sediment parameter.
Docs say 'Currently not used' but the code uses it: igen 'random generator code' is used in gcycl.f90:82-88 (called from cli_wgnread.f90:41,88) to reseed the weather-generator random numbers.

Docs say 'Currently not used' but the code uses it: the column is pestgwfact 'pesticide groundwater mixing factor' (basin_module.f90:85), used in aqu_1d_control.f90:337 'flow_mm = aqu_d(iaq)%stor * bsn_prm%pestgwfact + ...'. Docs label lin_sed (also the example header) belongs to a SWAT2012 channel sediment parameter.

Docs say 'Currently not used' but the code uses it: rsd_covco 'residue cover factor for computing frac of cover' is used in ero_cfactor.f90:69 'rsd_covfact = exp_w(-bsn_prm%rsd_covco * rsd_sumfac)'; that branch always runs because ero_cfactor.f90:51 forces cfac = 1.
Docs say 'Currently not used' but the code uses it: scoef 'channel storage coefficient (0-1)' is used in Muskingum routing ch_rtmusk.f90:153 (called from sd_channel_control3.f90:170).
Docs 'plnt_pop': 'Plant population'. uses(pcomdb%pl%pop) -> reads=none.

Docs 'real' (default 110.0); code days_mat is 'integer' (plant_data_module.f90:42). List-directed integer input rejects a value written as '110.00000' - which is how the refdata Osu_1hru example (Editor v2.2.0) writes it.
Docs type cell says 'read' (typo for real); code gmaxfr is real (plant_data_module.f90:72)

Docs 'Fraction of field capacity to initiate growth of tropical plants during monsoon season'. Code comment for frsw_gro says '30 day sum of P-PET to initiate growth of tropical plants' (plant_data_module.f90:99-100), and no code reads pldb%frsw_gro, so the value has no effect in 62.0.1.
Docs: 'Residue factor for percent cover equation'. uses(pldb%rsd_pctcov) -> only plantparm_init.f90:30 'if (pldb(ic)%rsd_pctcov <= 0.0) pldb(ic)%rsd_pctcov = 0.4'; never read afterwards.

items.page: relative humidity data file (*.hmd listed in hmd.cli)
items.detail: Docs: 'Time step of the relative humidity data'. uses(hmd%tstep) -> reads=none; data read as daily (cli_hmeas.f90:112).

Docs 'dlr: Currently not used' (type real). Code reads dr_name, a character(16) 'name of dr in delratio.del' (hydrograph_module.f90:493), and uses it: dr_ru.f90:20 'calc'/'0' computes a time-of-concentration delivery ratio, dr_ru.f90:36 'full'/'1' sets ratio 1, and hru_fr_change.f90:52-54 matches it to delratio.del names. Type also differs (docs real, code character).

Same column (elem_def, ru_module.f90:12) but nothing resolves it: grep 'dbsc%elem_def' finds no use; rout_unit.def is read independently in record order (ru_read_elements.f90:118-126). Docs present it as an active pointer.

Docs 'dlr: Delivery ratio' with empty Type cell. Code column elem_dr is a character pointer (ru_module.f90:13) that nothing resolves (grep 'dbsc%elem_dr': no use); per-element delivery ratios come from rout_unit.ele dr_name (dr_ru.f90:20,36). Docs give neither type nor 'not used' note.

Docs 'sed_stl': 'Sediment settling rate'. uses(sed_stlr) under any parent -> only cal_parm_select.f90:844. Settling uses sed_stlr_co computed from d50 (res_read.f90:143 'exp(-0.184 * res_prm(ires)%sed%d50)').
Docs 'stl_vel': 'Sediment settling velocity' (m/d). uses(velsetlr) under any parent -> only cal_parm_select.f90:848.
Docs 'q_rate': 'Flow rate of the septic tank effluent' (m^3/d). uses(sepdb%qs) -> reads=none.
Docs 'area': 'Average area of drainfield of individual septic systems' (m^2). uses(sep%area) -> reads=none.
Docs 'cha_dist': 'Distance from septic system to the stream' (km). uses(sep%strm_dist) -> reads=none.
Docs 'residents': 'Number of permanent residents in the house'. uses(sep%cap) -> reads=none.
Docs 'sep_dens': 'Number of septic systems per square kilometer'. uses(sep%density) -> reads=none.
Docs 'path: Currently not used'. Code pathc is matched against path_hru.ini records: hru_read.f90:102 'if (sol_plt_ini(isp_ini)%pathc == path_soil_ini(ics)%name)'.
Docs: 'Soil water fraction at the beginning of the simulation'. uses(sol_plt_ini%sw_frac) -> reads=none. Initial soil water comes from parameters.bsn sw_init (bsn_prm%ffcb, hydro_init.f90:88).

Docs 'dp_tot': 'Maximum rooting depth' (mm). uses(soildb%s%zmx) -> only copy soils_init.f90:64 to sol%s%zmx; uses(sol%s%zmx) -> reads=none. The HRU limit soil%zmx is set from the profile depth instead: writers(soil%zmx) -> hydro_init.f90:127 'soil(j)%zmx = soil(j)%phys(nly)%d' and mgt_plantop.f90:69.

Docs 'wnd_dir: Name of the wind direction station (currently not used)'. The 62.0.1 record (type weather_codes_station_char, climate_module.f90:115-125) has no wind-direction field. The 8th value on the line is read into petgage, so a file written per the docs (or the Editor v2.2.0 example, whose header also says wnd_dir) has its wnd_dir value taken as the PET gage name; cli_staread.f90:89-92 then searches pet files for it. Docs 'cov50: Fraction of snow'. Code cov50 is 'frac of covmx at 50% snow cover' (hru_module.f90:80): the fraction of covmx at which the area is 50% snow covered. The docs text is truncated to the point of not identifying the quantity.

Docs 'snow_h2o: Minimum snow water content' (mm). Code covmx is 'snow water content at full ground cover' (hru_module.f90:79): the snow water equivalent at and above which cover is 100%. The docs text drops 'that corresponds to 100% snow cover' from the SWAT definition, so as written it describes a lower limit on snow water, a different quantity. (Raised after ANT gemma26 flagged it; audit first had OK.)
